name: RCourier India Parcel Tracking
author: rabbitmarketinghouse

sections.description:
RCourier tracks Indian couriers by AWB number inside WooCommerce, and that includes the local and regional couriers that global tracking plugins leave out. Type or scan an AWB on the orders list, and the plugin looks up the parcel with the courier, keeps the order status in step with it, emails your shopper, and shows live tracking on your own website. Most tracking plugins are built for UPS, FedEx and the big international carriers. RCourier is built for how Indian stores ship: national carriers, local couriers, cash on delivery.

Which couriers can it track?

ARC Carrier; Accurate Freight Carrier; Amazon Logistics; Anjani Courier; Aramex; Blue Dart; DHL; DTDC; Delex Courier; Delhivery; Dotzot Courier; Ecom Express; Ekart (Flipkart); FedEx; FedEx India; First Flight Courier; Flyking Courier; Franch Express; GMS Worldwide Courier; GarudaVega Courier; Gati; Gati Kwe Courier; Gojavas Courier; India Post; Jaipur Golden; Janco Ecommerce; Levi Express; Lexship Courier; MOVIN Express; Madhur Courier; Mahindra Logistics; Mark Express; Maruti Courier; NITCO Roadways; Nandan Courier; NuvoEx Courier; OM Logistics; Overnite Courier; Pickrr Courier; Procure Logistics; Professional Courier; Registered Post (India Post); Rivigo Courier; ST Courier; Safexpress; Safexpress India Courier; Shadowfax; Shiprocket; Shree Anjani Courier; Shree Mahavir Courier; Shree Maruti; Shree Nandan Courier; Shree Tirupati Courier; Skyking (Sky Express); Skyman Air Express Courier; SpOton Courier; Speed Post; TCI Express Courier; TCI Freight; TCI XPS Courier; Tirupati Courier; Trackon; V-Trans; V-Xpress; VRL Logistics; Vichare Courier; XpressBees.

One AWB box works for all of them. If your courier is missing, tell us in the support forum and we will look at adding it.

What you can do

  • Add an AWB in seconds. Type or scan it into a box on the orders list or the order page and press Enter. The order is marked Shipped, and the shopper is emailed as soon as the courier reports the parcel moving.
  • Add many AWBs from a spreadsheet. Download the orders that still need a number, fill in the AWB on your computer, upload it, check the preview and save. Undo the whole batch within 24 hours.
  • Show shoppers live tracking on your site. A clean tracking page shows the parcel’s progress without sending them to a courier’s website. It also appears on My Account and the thank-you page.
  • Let orders follow the parcel. Choose whether a saved AWB marks the order Shipped and whether delivery marks it Delivered or Completed.
  • Handle cash on delivery. The shopper sees the amount to pay on delivery.
  • Split orders into parcels. Ship part of an order now and the rest later; the order shows Partly shipped until everything is on its way.
  • Get told about late parcels. A daily email lists parcels that have not moved, and parcels the courier stopped reporting after 7 days are flagged so you can check them by hand.
  • Print packing slips. A barcode and QR slip in 4×6, A6 or A4.
  • Work with other tracking plugins. Shared tracking-number data is kept in the format other plugins read, and you can import numbers from them.
  • Link a shipping aggregator. If you ship through an aggregator, AWBs can arrive on your orders by themselves.

Who is it for?

Indian WooCommerce stores that ship with Delhivery, Blue Dart, DTDC, XpressBees, India Post and other couriers, and want one place to enter AWB numbers and one tracking page for their shoppers.

External services

This plugin connects your store to the RCourier service, which fetches courier progress for the tracking numbers you add and sends it back to your store. Nothing is sent until you connect your store.

RCourier API (https://rcourier.automationforbusiness.in)

  • What is sent: for each parcel you add, the tracking number, the courier, and your order number so the two can be matched; your store’s web address and name when you connect. Requests are signed with a key created when you connect, and, as with any WordPress request, carry WordPress’s standard user agent, which includes your site’s address.
  • When you use automatic courier detection, the tracking number you type is also sent to RCourier while you type it, so it can suggest the courier (the number formats are kept on RCourier’s servers, not in this plugin).
  • When: when you save an AWB, when the plugin checks for new status in the background (about every 30 minutes) or when you or a shopper press Refresh, and when you open the Account tab.
  • What is not sent: your shoppers’ names, addresses, phone numbers or email addresses, and no payment details. The one exception is only if you link a shipping aggregator and choose to send it an order (by the button, or by turning on automatic sending): then that order’s shipping facts (the recipient’s name, phone number and delivery address, the items, the weight and the cash-on-delivery amount) are passed through RCourier to the aggregator you linked. Email addresses and payment details are never part of it.

Courier websites (links only)

  • The plugin shows a link to the courier’s own tracking page next to a parcel, for example when live status is not available. Nothing is requested from those sites by the plugin: your browser or your shopper’s browser goes there only when the link is clicked, and the tracking number is part of that address.
  • Sites linked: ecomexpress.in, ekartlogistics.com, track.amazon.in, tracker.shadowfax.in, tracking.dtdc.com, bluedart.com, delhivery.com, dhl.com, fedex.com, gati.com, indiapost.gov.in, tpcindia.com, trackoncourier.com and xpressbees.com. Each courier’s terms and privacy policy are on its own website.

RCourier account site (https://rcourier.automationforbusiness.in/console)

  • What is sent: when you click Connect, your browser is sent to this site to sign in with an email code and authorize your store. Your store’s web address and name are passed along so you can confirm what you are connecting. Any payment is handled there by Razorpay.
  • When: only when you connect or manage your account.

Terms of service: https://rcourier.automationforbusiness.in/terms
Privacy policy: https://rcourier.automationforbusiness.in/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce, then this plugin.
  2. Follow the setup wizard (WooCommerce > RCourier setup wizard). It connects your store to RCourier, asks how you ship, which couriers you use and how orders should change status.
  3. Type your first AWB on the WooCommerce orders list and press Enter.
sections.faq:
How do I add an AWB number to a WooCommerce order?

Open WooCommerce > Orders, type or scan the AWB into the box on the order’s row, choose the courier if asked, and press Enter. You can also do it from the order page or upload many at once from a spreadsheet.

How do I show courier tracking to my customers in WooCommerce?

The plugin adds a tracking page, a card on My Account order pages and the thank-you page, and a Track button on the orders list. Shoppers see live progress on your own site, and the shipped and delivered emails link to it.

Which Indian couriers does it track?

More than 60, national and local: Delhivery, Blue Dart, DTDC, XpressBees, Ekart, Ecom Express, India Post, Speed Post, Shadowfax, Amazon Logistics, Gati, Trackon, Professional Courier, TCI Express, Safexpress, VRL Logistics and many smaller regional couriers. The full list is in the description above.

What happens when a parcel is not delivered after 7 days?

Tracking stops after 7 days. The order shows “Check by hand”, the parcel is listed in the daily late-parcel email, and you can follow it up with the courier.

Do I need an account?

Yes. Tracking runs on the RCourier service, so you sign in once with an email code (no password) and connect your store.

Does it work with high-performance order storage (HPOS)?

Yes. The plugin reads and writes orders only through WooCommerce’s order API and declares HPOS compatibility.

What happens to my data if I deactivate or delete the plugin?

Deactivating puts every order whose status we changed back to what it was. Deleting the plugin keeps your tracking history unless you tick “Delete all RCourier data when the plugin is deleted” under WooCommerce > RCourier settings > Account.

Can I use another tracking plugin for what shoppers see?

Yes. If another tracking plugin is active you can choose which one shows tracking to shoppers; RCourier then stays out of shopper emails and My Account.

Does it show a credit link on my site?

It is an optional box in the setup wizard, ticked by default, and you can untick it there or turn it off any time in the shopper settings. Nothing in the plugin needs it.

Documentation and support

Setup guide, adding AWBs, the shopper tracking page, the full courier list and the FAQ are at https://rabbitmarketinghouse.in/docs/rcourier/. For help, use the support forum here or https://rabbitmarketinghouse.in/docs/rcourier/support/.

Is anything sent without my say-so?

No. Nothing leaves your site until you agree in the setup wizard (the consent box must be ticked) and press Connect. See “External services” below for exactly what is sent.
sections.changelog:
0.1.1

  • Security hardening: nonce checks on every admin input, and all printed markup is escaped on output.

0.1.0

  • First release: AWB entry on the orders list and order page, spreadsheet import and export, order status automation, tracking page, My Account card, shopper emails, setup wizard, settings, privacy tools. Aggregator link (AWBs arrive on orders by themselves, send orders across), packing slips, check a number with the couriers, return AWBs, shipping-method to courier defaults, late-parcel email and view, reports.
